newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-LASER BEAM AIMED AT SEVILLA GOALKEEPER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LASER BEAM AIMED AT SEVILLA GOALKEEPER.

text.p: An unidentified fan armed with a laser tried to distract Sevilla goalkeeper Monchi Rodrgiuez during Monday's 3-0 defeat at Hercules.
Television pictures showed a red light about the size of a small coin on the goalkeeper's face at corners and free-kicks. Lasers can cause permanent eye damage and even blindness.
"There was some kind of laser, but it didn't affect me at any time." said Monchi.
